source.rationale: FIX E, and it is a safety fixture, not a tidiness one. `_isDisambig` only asks whether the GATE raised a picker; the roster ladder above can still have reassigned `last_result_set` to the CS MEMBER roster on the same turn (`_mem`). Without the `selection_context === 'disambiguation'` clause, `_cpBornNow` is true here and this node persists the member roster under `picker_last_result_set` / `picker_selection_context: 'disambiguation'` - a sticky, invisible carry of the arming pin on the CS-assign path, wearing the one label the carry is willing to keep. The parser's output_exchange opens its member arm on that context and can emit `preferred_assignee_id`, i.e. a real assignment with the staff email/WhatsApp ripple, for a customer who was never shown a member list on the turn they replied to. cs-offer-gate's g4-no-double-picker now refuses to BUILD this turn; this clause is the independent second lock, so the carry stays shut even if g4 is ever widened or bypassed.
